validate_metadata.description: Enable generation of the [Metadata] section for appstream-util validation rules.

strict.description: Enforce strict compliance with AppStream specification during validation (equivalent to --strict in CLI).

allowed_languages.description: List of ISO 639 language codes permitted in translations. Used by appstream-util validate to check locale usage.

validation_rules.description: Custom validation rules as key=value pairs, e.g., 'IconRequired=true'. Each item must have 'key' and 'value' fields of string type. See appstream-util(1) --help and AppStream spec for valid keys/values. Note: This is *not* a direct config file format, but appstream-util accepts --rule KEY=VALUE on the command line, so we model external rule injection here for tooling automation purposes. Not a real on-disk config section, but useful for reproducible config generation (e.g., by CI).

validation_rules.items.description: A single validation rule. Each rule is a key-value pair (both string). Keys and values must conform to appstream-util(1) --help syntax and AppStream spec (e.g., 'IconRequired', 'IconSizeMin=48').

validation_rules.items.key.description: The validation rule key (e.g., IconRequired, IconSizeMin).

validation_rules.items.value.description: The validation rule value (e.g., true, false, 48). Must be a string representation as expected by appstream-util.
